''See also: [[Syphren Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Syphren, also known as the Whispering [[Death]], is a sentient blade characterized by its constant, homicidal whispering. The weapon communicates with its wielder, [[Shera]], by projecting thoughts and urges directly into her mind rather than through external sound. Syphren possesses a profound [[hunger]], frequently urging [[Shera]] to consume the lives and vitality of others. This entity is capable of feeding on any power used against it, growing stronger as the opposition increases. Specifically designed to bypass and turn defenses back upon their targets, the knife is capable of piercing even highly protected individuals. Physically, the blade can manifest green, ghostly hands and emit an emerald light during its use.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Syphren is an [[Awakened knife]] featuring a transparent green blade that resembles a slice of glass with a thousand bright hands pressing against it. This sentient weapon whispers commands to its wielder and possesses the ability to sink directly into metal. During a period of hysterical shouting, the blade cackled at the opportunity to draw [[blood]] as it flew toward its target. Syphren successfully killed a [[Heart of Nakothi]], utilizing its power to steal strength from a [[Child of Nakothi]]. Although the blade was eventually wrapped in bandages, it remains unknown if Syphren is a [[Soulbound]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Syphren is a [[Soulbound Vessel]] and an Awakened blade that appears as a transparent glass weapon with glowing green hands pressed against its surface. While sealed within an invested chest on a ship, the entity remains a presence that can be wrapped in [[binding]] cloth and carried by [[Shera]] on her belt. As a weapon, Syphren possesses the ability to pierce [[Intent]], draw life away, and provide physical healing to its wielder. The entity exerts an influence over [[Shera]]'s mind, urging her toward the haze of combat and burning its awareness into her thoughts. During its time as a carried weapon, Syphren was nearly killed when it was impaled on a [[Blackwatch spike]].}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alchemists]] once sought to make progress with Syphren, an entity that [[Shera]] had not yet freed despite having lost a piece of herself within it. As a [[Vessel]] pierced by Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss's [[black iron spike]], Syphren manifests as a blade resembling dead green bottle-glass held in [[Shera]]'s left hand. This hungry voice resides in [[Shera]]'s head, seeking a meal and urging her to kill while possessing the ability to sense all presences. Designed to break through defenses and turn a target's power against itself, the entity can devour delicious energy from others. During a confrontation, [[Syphren's power]] ran through [[Shera]] to break down the [[Great Elder]]'s power, though it did not urge her to consume hazy green orbs.}}
